mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_expense_record (category_id, expense_amount, expense_date, expense_type, remark, create_name, create_time, update_name,update_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{expenseAmount}, #{expenseDate}, #{expenseType}, #{remark}, #{createName}, NOW(), #{updateName}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category_id = VALUES(category_id), expense_amount = VALUES(expense_amount), expense_date = VALUES(expense_date), expense_type = VALUES(expense_type), remark = VALUES(remark), create_name = VALUES(create_name), create_time = VALUES(create_time), update_name = VALUES(update_name), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
